title: Last-Mile Innovations Every Shipper Should Know
summary: Discover how last-mile innovations like smart routing, crowdshipping, and micro-fulfillment help Universal Logistics deliver faster and flexible service.
body_markdown: In logistics, the last mile is where customer expectations meet real-world challenges. It’s also where new ideas can make the biggest impact. From tighter delivery windows to higher shipping costs, the final leg of a shipment’s journey often demands the most time, energy, and resources. At Universal Logistics Services, we keep a close eye on what’s next, so your freight keeps moving forward, right to the door.
